title: Diastereomeric Branched-Ester dBET1 Analogs Exhibit Conformation-Dependent Differences in Passive Membrane Permeability.
authors: Abdelwahid, Mazin A S; Hayakawa, Eisuke; Hirai, Keigo; Ishii, Mayumi; Kanamitsu, Kayoko; Yasuda, Saori; Ohtake, Fumiaki; Sato, Shinichi; Tomoshige, Shusuke; Ishikawa, Minoru
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PROTAC分子的膜渗透性与构象关系，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于核酸-蛋白结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) represent a promising therapeutic modality, but their clinical translation is often hindered by poor pharmacokinetic properties associated with their location in the "beyond Rule of 5" chemical space. Using the BRD4 degrader dBET1 as a model, this study explored a dual approach to improve the cellular permeability of PROTACs by combining amide-to-ester substitution with the strategic linker methylation to induce stereochemistry-driven conformational modulation. Substitution with ester enhanced both permeability and degradation potency, while methylation afforded two diastereomers with different permeability profiles. Steered molecular dynamics and enhanced conformational sampling in polar and nonpolar environments revealed distinct chameleonic behaviors, with the more permeable diastereomer 2b adopting folded conformations with a lower solvent-accessible 3D polar surface area in the nonpolar environment. These findings were supported by 2D NMR and hydrogen-bond acidity analyses (A(NMR)). Notably, low-energy "congruent conformation" accessible in both environments was identified for 2b. This work establishes a viable strategy for the design of membrane-permeable PROTACs.
abstract_zh: 蛋白降解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）代表了一种有前景的治疗模式，但其临床转化常因位于“超越Rule of 5”化学空间中而伴随的药代动力学特性不佳而受阻。本研究以BRD4降解剂dBET1为模型，探索了一种双重策略，通过将酰胺到酯的替换与策略性连接子甲基化相结合，以诱导立体化学驱动的构象调节，从而改善PROTACs的细胞通透性。酯替换增强了通透性和降解效力，而甲基化则产生了两种具有不同通透性特征的非对映异构体。在极性和非极性环境中的受控分子动力学和增强构象采样揭示了不同的变色龙行为，其中通透性更高的非对映异构体2b在非极性环境中采用折叠构象，并具有较低的溶剂可及三维极性表面积。这些发现得到了二维核磁共振和氢键酸性分析（A(NMR)）的支持。值得注意的是，在两种环境中均可访问的低能“一致构象”被识别为2b的特征。这项工作为设计膜通透性PROTACs建立了一种可行策略。
